chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 601: A Chaos Stele & The Eighteen Fiendgods Technique
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning investigates a mysterious black stele that even heartforce cannot detect. He begins to unlock its secrets, obtaining the heaven-defying 'Eighteen Fiendgods of Taowu' technique.
og_title: A Discovery from Beyond the Three Realms!
og_description: Ji Ning finds a stele that defies all logic, holds seven techniques, and is numbered 'seventeen'. The power-ups are about to get real.
twitter_description: Ji Ning gets his hands on a treasure that can split him into eighteen invincible copies. The real journey begins!

lore_anchors.definition: A magic treasure born from or forged within the primordial Chaos beyond the Three Realms, whose power far exceeds that of ordinary Innate spirit-treasures.
A cultivator's spiritual perception, a form of psychic awareness used to probe the environment and detect energy.
A rare and supremely powerful metaphysical force derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, far more esoteric than divine sense.
A legendary cultivation technique allowing one to split their soul and body into eighteen perfect copies, each potentially equal in power to the original.
The refined, pure Yang-aspect energy of a True Immortal, superior in quality to ordinary divine power or immortal ki.
